item.text: The package-level behavior is extensively covered now. I’m doing a final regression-focused source comparison against the cached 0.2.2 release to look for small semantic changes hidden among the larger storage/runtime refactors.

No additional implementation defect was confirmed in this pass. The source comparison against the cached 0.2.2 release showed the leader-election changes are limited to outgoing-message handling and synchronizing a manually obtained leadership ballot; no new semantic discrepancy was found there.

The audit remains at 24 confirmed findings. Current verification status:

- Default core and runtime tests pass.
- All shipped runtime tests pass with `--all-features`.
- The package-level exhaustive feature matrix passes.
- Randomized crash/restart testing found no decided-prefix conflict.
- The highest-impact issues remain delta-snapshot corruption, persistent failed-write leakage, LFU clone corruption, timeout retry duplication, and LRU bincode deserialization failure.

The complete report with code references, conditions, reproduction commands, and retained outputs is at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
